hypothesis: Two fixed alternatives: BB2 close reentry tests exhaustion without late confirmation; W/M tests weakening of a second price extreme before neckline breakout. Neither is assumed profitable.
baseline: Unchanged original BB3 reversal engine, next contiguous open, fixed signal-center TP and symmetric RR1 SL
indicator: SMA20 and population standard deviation20 of close, includes current closed bar; +/-2sigma recomputed from cached OHLC. Require 20 observations. Original baseline uses original cached features unchanged.

entry_rules.bb2_reentry: Buy previous close strictly below its lower2band then current close strictly between its current lower2/upper2 bands; sell mirrors above upper2band. Bars must be contiguous. No candle direction or other filter. Next contiguous open, fixed tick-rounded signal center target, actual reward>=3pips.
entry_rules.wm: Separate buy/sell states. Strict close local pivot left2/right2, unique versus all4 neighbors, known at pivot+2 close. First pivot close outside corresponding2band. Second pivot close strictly lower(buy)/higher(sell) than first but inside BOTH current2bands. At least one intervening close reaches own SMA20 in rebound direction. Neckline maxhigh/minlow of strictly intervening bars. Second-pivot confirmation close or subsequent close must strictly break neckline. Entry nextcontiguousopen. Expire when currentindex-firstpivotindex>60. Any low/high after secondpivot breaches secondpivot candlelow/high cancels BEFORE breakout, including confirmationbars and breakoutbar. First breakout consumes pattern even if fill fails. A newer outside qualifying firstpivot replaces earlier first only if no validsecond forms. Opposite simultaneous signals skipped and both consumed. Gap resets states and pivotwindow. No extra trend/candle conditions.
